practiceReport.name: Saquon Barkley
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Perimeter speed/cut position (RB) — requires full deceleration/burst clearance on lower-body tags (76% Questionable baseline).
factors: Wednesday Limited Participation (LP); player toughness prior = 76%
practiceReport.beatComment: Barkley appeared to be nursing a left arm injury in the aftermath of Sunday's 19-16 win over the Steelers, but it was instead two different health concerns that resulted in him being included on the Eagles' first Week 12 injury report. The Eagles are facing a quick turnaround this week with a Thursday matchup against the Cowboys, so Barkley could be in line for only light activity over the next two days as the team aims to keep him as fresh as possible for that contest. Head coach Nick Sirianni hasn't yet offered any indication that Barkley is in jeopardy of sitting out Thanksgiving Day.

practiceReport.name: Jonathan Jones
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Perimeter speed/cut position (CB) — requires full deceleration/burst clearance on lower-body tags (76% Questionable baseline).
factors: Questionable tag adjusted by player career prior (76%)
practiceReport.beatComment: Jones suffered an ankle injury during the Eagles' 19-16 win over the Steelers on Sunday. Philadelphia didn't hold practice Monday, so his participation over the next two sessions will shed light on his chances of playing against Dallas on Thanksgiving Day. Quinyon Mitchell (hamstring) was also injured in Week 11, so the Eagles could very well have Riq Woolen and Kelee Ringo as the outside cornerbacks against a Cowboys offense that scored seven touchdowns (four passing, three rushing) in a 51-30 win over the Titans on Sunday.

practiceReport.name: Quinyon Mitchell
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Every-down starter workload (92% snaps) — 82% active conversion baseline when logging Limited Friday reps.
factors: Questionable tag adjusted by player career prior (82%)
practiceReport.beatComment: Mitchell injured his left hamstring in the second half, and medical staff have determined that the injury is severe enough for the third-year defensive back to be sidelined for the remainder of Sunday's contest. Riq Woolen will take over at cornerback the rest of the way.

practiceReport.name: Dallas Goedert
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Veteran starter profile (9th NFL season, 74% snap share) — elevated Questionable active conversion (84%) & Wednesday maintenance tolerance.
factors: Wednesday Limited Participation (LP); player toughness prior = 84%
practiceReport.beatComment: Philadelphia gauged Goedert as limited to kick off Week 12 prep after he played 47 of 53 snaps while turning his lone target into a 38-yard reception during Sunday's 19-16 win over the Steelers. Goedert won't have much time to heal up from the shin issue while the Eagles prepare for a Thursday matchup with the Cowboys, but the fact that he avoided being listed as a non-participant on the first injury report of the week is generally a good sign for his chances of being cleared for game day.

practiceReport.name: Will Shipley
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Perimeter speed/cut position (RB) — requires full deceleration/burst clearance on lower-body tags (76% Questionable baseline).
practiceReport.beatComment: Shipley returned Sunday from a four-game absence due to a foot injury, and he finished that contest with four carries for nine yards and returned three kickoffs for 75 yards. He's still working through that foot issue, but he's now battling an illness, so his listed activity level over the next two days will be worth monitoring ahead of the Eagles' Thanksgiving Day contest against the Cowboys in Dallas. Shipley could operate in an elevated role on offense Thursday depending on the status of Saquon Barkley (neck/illness).

practiceReport.name: Tanner McKee
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Every-down starter workload (100% snaps) — 82% active conversion baseline when logging Limited Friday reps.
factors: Wednesday Limited Participation (LP); player toughness prior = 82%
practiceReport.beatComment: It's unclear when McKee picked up the injury, given that he didn't play a single snap during Sunday's 19-16 win over the Steelers while serving as Joe Milton's backup. The Eagles have two more practices on a short week, so McKee's participation in those sessions will determine whether he'll be available against the Cowboys on Thanksgiving Day. Rookie fifth-rounder Cole Payton would serve as the QB2 behind Milton if McKee cannot play Thursday.

practiceReport.name: DeVonta Smith
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Every-down starter workload (86% snaps) — 82% active conversion baseline when logging Limited Friday reps.
practiceReport.beatComment: Smith was targeted on 12 of Joe Milton's 21 passes in the wide receiver's first game since Week 6. Milton has thrown for just 310 yards without a touchdown pass through two starts for the Eagles, so expectations should be tempered for the team's passing game as a whole, but Smith has reclaimed his role as the team's top pass catcher. Smith could make the most of his hefty target share Thursday against the generous Dallas secondary.

practiceReport.name: Jalen Carter
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Every-down starter workload (84% snaps) — 82% active conversion baseline when logging Limited Friday reps.
practiceReport.beatComment: Carter informed the Eagles' medical staff while he was traveling to the stadium Sunday that his quadriceps was bothering him. The fifth-year defensive tackle has been cleared to suit up, but if he plays under a snap count or is available only as an emergency option, then Ty Robinson and Gabe Hall would be poised to take on larger roles on defense.

practiceReport.name: Michael Carter II
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Perimeter speed/cut position (CB) — requires full deceleration/burst clearance on lower-body tags (76% Questionable baseline).
practiceReport.beatComment: An abdominal injury prevented Carter from playing in Week 9 against the Giants. He had extra rest thanks to the Week 10 bye, and his full practice Friday was enough for him to avoid an injury tag for Sunday's contest. Carter's return gives the Eagles a boost in the secondary and another contributor on special teams.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Dontayvion Wicks
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Wicks missed the three games before the Eagles' Week 10 bye due to an ankle injury, and he was limited during Week 11 prep before the team tacked on a foot issue on Friday's practice report, after which he was ruled out for Sunday's contest against the Steelers. Per Tim McManus of ESPN.com, Wicks sustained the foot injury Friday, and it presumably led to his placement on IR. Wicks will be sidelined until at least Philadelphia's Week 15 matchup with Seattle on Saturday, Dec. 19.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Zack Baun
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Baun was held out of practice all week due to a back injury that he sustained against the Giants in Week 9. The injury is severe enough for him to require a stint on IR, which means he'll miss at least the next four games, so the earliest he can return is Week 15 against the Seahawks. Jeremiah Trotter figures to start alongside Jihaad Campbell at inside linebacker moving forward, beginning with Sunday's home tilt against the Steelers.
